title: spring.config.import (k8s)
description: The k8s provider has no bound prefix; it is consumed via spring.config.import=optional:k8s:<kind>/<name>?namespace=&key=&format=&kubeconfig=, where <kind> is configmap or secret

key.description: read only this data entry; default read every entry

format.description: override the parsed format; default inferred from each entry's extension
